mapper.sql: SELECT Q.QSTN_ANS_SN AS qstnAnsSn, Q.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, Q.QSTN_ANS_SE_CD AS qstnAnsSeCd, Q.QSTN_CN AS qstnCn, Q.ANS_CN AS ansCn, Q.RQT_MTTR_SN AS rqtMttrSn, Q.WRTR_ID AS wrtrId, Q.WRT_DT AS wrtDt, R.RQT_MTTR_NO AS rqtMttrNo, R.RQT_MTTR_NM AS rqtMttrNm, R.TOC_SN AS rqtTocSn FROM TB_QSTN_ANS Q LEFT JOIN TB_RQT_MTTR R ON R.RQT_MTTR_SN = Q.RQT_MTTR_SN
mapper.select: WHERE Q.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} ORDER BY R.RQT_MTTR_NO NULLS LAST, Q.QSTN_ANS_SN
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_QSTN_ANS (PBANC_SN, QSTN_ANS_SE_CD, QSTN_CN, ANS_CN, RQT_MTTR_SN, WRTR_ID, WRT_DT) VALUES (#{pbancSn}, #{qstnAnsSeCd}, #{qstnCn}, #{ansCn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{rqtMttrSn, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{wrtrId}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_RQT_MTTR WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND RQT_MTTR_SN = #{rqtMttrSn}
